Installation¶

Download the “input_system.yymps” file from here. Open up your GameMaker project, and in the menubar click on “Tools”>”Import Local Package”.

Then select the “input_system.yymps” file, and click “Open”.

Then this window pops up. Click on “Add All”, then “Import”.

Important!!!

This system requires two other packages to work! It requires my Essentials and JSON script pack. Do the same thing as above for both.

And you will also have to put the oInputManager object into the fist room. Otherwise the system won’t work!
